name: Utatane Yutori
source:
Childhood friend of the protagonist.
A mysterious girl who is famous as "eccentric girl", "delusional girl" etc.
Her actions are always contrary to expectations.
Naturally, everything is for the protagonist she loves.

"Underwear? I am wearing right now... Would you like to see it?"
